hero.title: Long-running Claude：面向科学计算的长任务 Agent 工作流
hero.en: The article explains how to run multi-day Claude Code workflows for scientific computing using memory, test oracles, and orchestration.
hero.zh: 文章说明如何用记忆文件、测试判据和编排循环，把 Claude Code 用于跨天运行的科学计算任务。

summary.lead: 这篇文章的重点不是让 Agent 盲目自治，而是为长时间科学计算任务建立可恢复、可验证、可监督的运行框架。

cards.title: 任务要有判据
cards.body: 适合 Agent 的科学任务通常范围清晰、成功标准明确，并且可以对照 reference implementation 或测试套件验证。

cards.title: 记忆必须外置
cards.body: CHANGELOG.md 把进展、失败路线、精度表和限制沉淀为可携带长期记忆，避免重复走死路。

cards.title: 运行要可恢复
cards.body: Git、tmux、SLURM 和提交规则把无人值守运行变成可观察、可恢复的工程流程。

cards.title: 编排补足能力
cards.body: Ralph loop 等模式在模型能力不足时提供脚手架，防止过早声称完成。

keyPoints.label: 核心判断
keyPoints.text: 长任务 Agent 的可靠性来自明确目标、测试判据、持久记忆和可恢复执行环境。

keyPoints.label: 边界条件
keyPoints.text: 这种方法适合成功标准清楚的工程化科学任务，不等同于开放式科学发现自动化。

keyPoints.label: 实践收益
keyPoints.text: 在合适问题上，Agent-driven development 可以把研究者数月到数年的实现工作压缩到数天级别。

sections.title: 科学家从紧控对话转向长任务 Agent

rows.en: Most scientists currently using AI agents work in a conversational loop, managing each step on a tight leash.
rows.zh: 多数科学家仍以对话方式紧控每一步。

rows.en: As models improve at long-horizon tasks, users can specify a high-level objective and let a team of agents work autonomously.
rows.zh: 随着模型长程能力提升，用户可以指定高层目标，让 Agent 团队自主推进。

sections.title: 哪些科学计算任务适合长时间 Agent

rows.en: Reimplementing a numerical solver, converting old Fortran software, and debugging against a reference implementation are good fits.
rows.zh: 重写数值求解器、迁移旧 Fortran 软件、对照参考实现调试，都是适合场景。

rows.en: The key prerequisites are well-scoped work, clear success criteria, and occasional rather than continuous human oversight.
rows.zh: 关键前提是范围清晰、成功标准明确，且不需要持续人工监督。

sections.title: 从 C 编译器到宇宙学 Boltzmann solver

rows.en: Claude previously worked across roughly 2,000 sessions to build a C compiler capable of compiling the Linux kernel.
rows.zh: Claude 曾跨约 2,000 个 session 构建可编译 Linux kernel 的 C 编译器。

rows.en: The article's concrete example is a differentiable cosmological Boltzmann solver in JAX.
rows.zh: 本文案例是在 JAX 中实现可微分的宇宙学 Boltzmann solver。

sections.title: 为什么 differentiable solver 有意义

rows.en: CLASS and CAMB are core scientific infrastructure for constraining cosmological models.
rows.zh: CLASS 和 CAMB 是约束宇宙学模型的核心科学基础设施。

rows.en: A differentiable solver propagates gradients and enables gradient-based inference, speeding up parameter estimation.
rows.zh: 可微分 solver 能传播梯度，支持基于梯度的推断，并加速参数估计。

sections.title: 长任务 Agent 的三个支点

rows.en: CLAUDE.md carries instructions and context for the overall plan.
rows.zh: CLAUDE.md 承载总体计划和规则。

rows.en: CHANGELOG.md acts as portable long-term memory and lab notes.
rows.zh: CHANGELOG.md 是可携带长期记忆和实验记录。

rows.en: A test oracle tells the agent whether scientific code is actually making progress.
rows.zh: test oracle 告诉 Agent 科学代码是否真的在进步。

sections.title: 用 Git、tmux 和 SLURM 管理无人值守运行

rows.en: Git makes progress visible, recoverable, and less likely to be lost when compute allocation ends.
rows.zh: Git 让进展可见、可恢复，也降低计算资源结束时丢失工作的风险。

rows.en: tmux lets Claude Code keep running on a compute node while the human detaches and checks occasionally.
rows.zh: tmux 让 Claude Code 在计算节点上持续运行，人类可断开后偶尔查看。

sections.title: 反复确认完成状态的编排模式

rows.en: The Ralph loop asks whether the agent is really done when it claims completion.
rows.zh: Ralph loop 在 Agent 声称完成时追问是否真的完成。

rows.en: The Ralph loop can be useful for long-running tasks since the agent will admit the task is not up to spec, and continue working until it is.
rows.zh: Ralph loop 对长任务有用，因为 Agent 会承认任务尚未达到规格，并继续工作直到达标。

rows.en: Claude reached sub-percent agreement across outputs, though the resulting solver was not production-grade.
rows.zh: Claude 在多个输出上达到亚百分比一致性，但结果并非生产级。

rows.en: The article argues that not running agents now carries an opportunity cost when projects have well-defined success criteria.
rows.zh: 文章认为，当项目有清晰成功标准时，不运行 Agent 本身也有机会成本。

groups.group: Scientific Infrastructure · 科学基础设施

rows.en: Boltzmann solvers like CLASS and CAMB are core pieces of scientific infrastructure in cosmology, allowing researchers to constrain cosmological models using data from surveys like Planck and the Simons Observatory.
rows.zh: CLASS 和 CAMB 等 Boltzmann solvers 是宇宙学中的核心 scientific infrastructure，使研究者能够用 Planck 和 Simons Observatory 等巡天数据约束 cosmological models。
rows.html: Boltzmann solvers like CLASS and CAMB are core pieces of scientific infrastructure in cosmology, allowing researchers to constrain cosmological models using data from surveys like Planck and the Simons Observatory.
rows.zhHtml: CLASS 和 CAMB 等 Boltzmann solvers 是宇宙学中的核心 scientific infrastructure，使研究者能够用 Planck 和 Simons Observatory 等巡天数据约束 cosmological models。

rows.en: A differentiable version, one that can propagate gradients through the full solver, enables the use of gradient-based inference methods and speeds up parameter estimation. Writing it in JAX gives automatic differentiation and compatibility with accelerators such as GPUs.
rows.zh: 一个 differentiable 版本可以让 gradients 贯穿整个 solver，从而使用 gradient-based inference methods，并加速 parameter estimation。用 JAX 编写则自然获得 automatic differentiation，并兼容 GPUs 等 accelerators。

groups.group: Why It Is Hard · 为什么难

rows.en: The task was not in the author's core scientific domain: he had high-level familiarity but not the expertise to complete it himself in any reasonable time frame. The point was to see if an agent could go further with minimal steering from a non-domain expert.
rows.zh: 这个任务并不在作者的 core scientific domain 中：他有高层次熟悉度，但没有能力在合理时间内独立完成。实验目的在于观察：在 non-domain expert 的 minimal steering 下，Agent 能否推进得更远。

rows.en: A Boltzmann solver is a deeply coupled pipeline. A small numerical error or poor approximation in modeling how the early universe recombines can subtly shift everything downstream.
rows.zh: Boltzmann solver 是 deeply coupled pipeline。建模早期宇宙 recombines 过程时，一个 small numerical error 或 poor approximation 都可能微妙地影响下游所有结果。

rows.en: The core ideas are a progress file, a test oracle, and an agent prompt with clear rules. The author uses an HPC cluster running the SLURM job scheduler, but the ideas apply regardless of where Claude Code runs.

groups.group: Memory and Oracle · 记忆与判据

rows.en: The progress file, conventionally CHANGELOG.md here, is the agent's portable long-term memory, acting as lab notes. It should track current status, completed tasks, failed approaches and why they did not work, accuracy tables, and known limitations.
rows.zh: 这里约定的 progress file 是 CHANGELOG.md，它是 Agent 的 portable long-term memory，类似 lab notes。它应记录当前状态、已完成任务、failed approaches 及其失败原因、accuracy tables 和 known limitations。

rows.en: Long-running autonomous scientific work depends on the agent having a way to know whether it is making progress. For scientific code, this could be a reference implementation, a quantifiable objective, or an existing test suite.
rows.zh: 长时间自主科学工作依赖一个前提：Agent 必须知道自己是否在进步。对科学代码而言，这可以是 reference implementation、quantifiable objective，或 existing test suite。

groups.group: Coordination and Loop · 协调与循环

rows.en: Git can be a good way to monitor and coordinate the agent's progress. The agent should commit and push after every meaningful unit of work, run tests before every commit, and never commit code that breaks existing passing tests.
rows.zh: Git 可以用来 monitor and coordinate Agent 的进展。Agent 应在每个 meaningful unit of work 后 commit and push，在每次提交前运行 tests，并且 never commit 会破坏现有通过测试的代码。

rows.en: The execution loop starts by iterating on the plan locally, then launching a Claude Code session inside tmux on a compute node. Because the session runs inside tmux, the human can detach and occasionally check progress.
rows.zh: execution loop 先在本地迭代计划，然后在 compute node 的 tmux 中启动 Claude Code session。由于会话运行在 tmux 中，人类可以 detach，之后偶尔检查进度。

groups.group: Ralph Loop and Result · Ralph 循环与结果

rows.en: The Ralph loop is an orchestration pattern that kicks the agent back into context when it claims completion and asks if it is really done. It helps counter agentic laziness and can keep the agent working until the success criterion is met.
rows.zh: Ralph loop 是一种 orchestration pattern：当 Agent 声称完成时，把它踢回上下文，并追问是否真的完成。它用于对抗 agentic laziness，让 Agent 持续工作直到满足 success criterion。
rows.html: The Ralph loop is an orchestration pattern that kicks the agent back into context when it claims completion and asks if it is really done. It helps counter agentic laziness and can keep the agent working until the success criterion is met.
rows.zhHtml: Ralph loop 是一种 orchestration pattern：当 Agent 声称完成时，把它踢回上下文，并追问是否真的完成。它用于对抗 agentic laziness，让 Agent 持续工作直到满足 success criterion。

rows.en: Claude worked on the project from scratch over a few days, reaching sub-percent agreement with the reference CLASS implementation across its outputs. The result is not production-grade, but it demonstrates that agent-driven development can compress months or years of researcher work into days.
rows.zh: Claude 从零开始在几天内推进项目，使多个输出与 reference CLASS implementation 达到 sub-percent agreement。结果并非 production-grade，但它展示了 agent-driven development 可以把数月甚至数年的 researcher work 压缩到几天。
